title: Shared definitions for the Flame in Freefall hand-over contract

module_id.description: Engine folder name under data/modules/, for example flame-temperature. _mock is the development example.

psi_id.description: A PSI investigation ID, for example PSI-69.

test_id.description: <PSI ID>/<the table's own test number>, with #<row> appended where the table repeats a number. Examples: PSI-69/114, PSI-25/B1, PSI-101/57#58.

provenance.description: How the number was obtained. Shown as a badge on every number.

source.description: Where the number comes from in the PSI repository.

file.description: The PSI file name the number was read from.

link.description: A link to the file or investigation on psi.nasa.gov.

value.description: The value itself. A number for measurements; a string or boolean only for categorical outcomes (for example 'Extinction').

unit.description: Unit of the value. Use "1" for dimensionless numbers and "" for categorical values.

n.description: How many tests or samples the value rests on.

file_name.description: A path relative to the engine folder. No leading slash, no '..'.
